senses.gloss: तगरः A kind of plant; Mb. 13. 104. 87.

तगरः + .{@-रम्, तगरकम्@} A kind of perfume (Tabernaemontana coronaria)
 and a fragrant powder prepared from it; Nm. {@तगरिकः, -की@} A seller
 of Tagara powder.
